title: RetailLink Vendor: POS Outage — Firmware Update

transcript.speaker: R. Thompson
transcript.text: Hello, this is R. Thompson from RetailLink Vendor Support. We’re calling regarding the widespread point-of-sale terminal outage across your airport’s retail tenants. Our systems confirm the v4.2.1 firmware update pushed at 9:30 this morning completed successfully on all 47 terminals. The terminals are online, but they’re not reaching your payment gateway. We’ve verified the terminal network configuration is unchanged and compliant. This appears to be a network connectivity issue on your end, not a terminal fault.

transcript.speaker: R. Thompson
transcript.text: Also, for your awareness — we flagged unusual API queries against our cloud portal from an IP address we don’t recognize. It occurred yesterday, shortly after the update. We reported it to our security team. Unrelated, probably, but we wanted to pass it along.

transcript.speaker: Jordan Kelley
transcript.text: Understood. We’re investigating. Thank you for the update.

voiceStyles.R. Thompson: Male, mid-40s, calm, professional, slight background typing noise
voiceStyles.Jordan Kelley: Male, late 30s, focused, slightly strained, background keyboard clicks

instructorNote: This inject introduces a red herring: the firmware update is legitimate and successful, but the API anomaly re-energizes the external attack theory. IT should now focus on network path validation, not vendor systems.
